description: This file implements lease management in the etcd client, including lease creation, revocation, TTL retrieval, keep-alive management, and internal lease state handling.

classes.name: Lease
classes.description: Interface defining lease operations such as grant, revoke, TTL, keep-alive, and close.

classes.name: lessor
classes.description: Internal implementation of the Lease interface, managing lease state and gRPC streams.

classes.name: keepAlive
classes.description: Struct managing multiple keep-alive channels and timing for a specific lease.

methods.name: Grant
methods.description: Creates a new lease with specified TTL.

methods.name: TimeToLive
methods.description: Retrieves TTL and attached keys for a lease.

methods.name: KeepAlive
methods.description: Maintains a lease alive by streaming keep-alive requests.

methods.name: keepAliveCtxCloser
methods.description: Closes keep-alive channels associated with a specific context.

methods.name: closeRequireLeader
methods.description: Closes channels requiring a leader in the cluster.

methods.name: keepAliveOnce
methods.description: Performs a single keep-alive RPC for a lease.

methods.name: recvKeepAliveLoop
methods.description: Loop receiving keep-alive responses from the server.

methods.name: recvKeepAlive
methods.description: Processes a keep-alive response, updating internal state.

methods.name: deadlineLoop
methods.description: Removes lease keep-alives that have timed out.

methods.name: sendKeepAliveLoop
methods.description: Sends periodic keep-alive requests for active leases.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the keepAlive object, closing channels.
